reading.title: The Impact of Renewable Energy on Global Economy
reading.passage: Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power have revolutionized the global energy landscape over the past decade. Countries investing heavily in renewable infrastructure have experienced significant economic growth and job creation. The transition to clean energy not only reduces carbon emissions but also decreases dependence on fossil fuels, leading to more stable energy prices. However, the initial capital investment required for renewable projects remains substantial, posing challenges for developing nations.

questions.q: According to the passage, which of the following is a benefit of renewable energy?
options: B) Reduced carbon emissions and stable energy prices
C) Higher energy costs for consumers
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '깨끗한 에너지로의 전환은 탄소 배출을 감소시키고 화석 연료에 대한 의존도를 줄여 더 안정적인 에너지 가격으로 이어진다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What is the main challenge mentioned for developing nations?
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 '재생에너지 프로젝트에 필요한 초기 자본 투자가 상당하여 개발 도상국에 도전을 제시한다'고 설명합니다.

questions.q: Which countries have experienced positive economic outcomes?
options: C) Countries investing heavily in renewable infrastructure
D) Countries still using fossil fuels
questions.explanation: 본문의 두 번째 문장에서 '재생 에너지 기반시설에 많이 투자한 국가들이 상당한 경제 성장과 일자리 창출을 경험했다'고 명시됩니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made life easier but less meaningful.' Provide specific examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 당신의 명확한 입장을 제시하세요. 예: 'In my opinion, technology has made life easier while also creating new forms of meaning and connection.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장: 기술이 일상 업무를 어떻게 단순화했는지 구체적 예시 제시 (예: 자동화, 의료 기술)
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장: 기술이 새로운 기회나 의미 있는 경험을 어떻게 창출했는지 설명 (예: 온라인 교육, 소셜 네트워킹, 원격 근무)
structure.conclusion: 양쪽 입장을 균형있게 정리하며 결론 도출. 예: '따라서 기술의 영향은 우리가 어떻게 사용하는지에 달려있습니다.'

useful_phrases: For example, smartphones allow us to...
On the other hand, some argue that...
In conclusion, technology is a tool that...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in a traditional office. Others prefer to work from home. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer working from home because...
One reason is that remote work allows me to have more flexibility...
Another advantage is that I can save time and money on commuting...
Furthermore, I find it easier to concentrate in a quiet home environment...
However, I understand that some people need the social interaction of an office...
sample_points: 원격 근무의 유연성: 자신의 일정에 맞춰 작업할 수 있고 통근 시간 절약 가능
생산성 향상: 집중력 저해 요소 감소로 업무 효율성 증가, 개인의 일-생활 균형 개선

listening.title: Campus Library Renovation Project
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I heard the library is being renovated. How long will it take? Librarian: Yes, we're upgrading our facilities to include more study spaces and modern technology. The project should take about four months, starting next month. We're renovating the third floor first to add quiet study rooms and collaborative workspaces. Student: Will we still be able to access the books during construction? Librarian: Absolutely. We've arranged temporary shelving on the first two floors, and the circulation desk will remain open. We're also implementing a digital catalog system, so you can search and request books online. Student: That sounds helpful. When will the new study spaces be available? Librarian: The quiet study rooms should be ready in about six weeks, and the collaborative spaces will be completed by the end of the project. We're also adding charging stations and better lighting throughout the library.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the library renovation?
options: B) To upgrade facilities with more study spaces and modern technology
C) To close the library temporarily
D) To reduce the number of books
questions.explanation: 사서가 '더 많은 학습 공간과 최신 기술을 포함하여 시설을 업그레이드하고 있다'고 명확히 설명합니다.

questions.q: How long is the renovation expected to take?
questions.explanation: 사서가 '프로젝트는 약 4개월이 걸릴 것으로 예상된다'고 명시합니다.

questions.q: Which feature will be available first?
questions.explanation: 사서가 '조용한 학습실은 약 6주 안에 준비될 것'이라고 언급하여 다른 시설보다 먼저 완성될 것으로 설명합니다.
